title: rhipidoglossum tenerrimum
intro: Rhipidoglossum tenerrimum, commonly known as the Slender Gasteromycete, is a species of orchid. It is not well-documented for its medicinal properties, but it has been reported to have potential health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
